name: Curly Lizard 40
author: adamgiebl
description: Outlined teal checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: transform becomes translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Curly Lizard 40</title>
<style>
/* Curly Lizard 40 by adamgiebl — https://uiverse.io/adamgiebl/curly-lizard-40 */
.cyberpunk-checkbox {
  appearance: none;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 2px solid #30cfd0;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background-color: transparent;
  display: inline-block;
  position: relative;
  margin-right: 10px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.cyberpunk-checkbox:before {
  content: "";
  background-color: #30cfd0;
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0);
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.cyberpunk-checkbox:checked:before {
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
}

.cyberpunk-checkbox-label {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<label class="cyberpunk-checkbox-label">
<input type="checkbox" class="cyberpunk-checkbox">
Check me</label>

</body>
</html>
